title: A Wanderer's Honor - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: A Wanderer's Honor trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: A Wanderer's Honor phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. Same window as The Journey Home - both start in the Village of Lu, so both should be finished before moving on.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest Young Master Lan.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
